title: Melting Melody of Time
description: A hooded grim reaper-like figure in a flowing green robe stands in the midground, holding a melting green candle that drips wax and emits musical notes. In the foreground, a black octopus wearing a purple beret plays a green melting violin while positioned in a winding blue river containing floating melting clocks.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a hooded grim reaper in a dripping green robe holding a tall melting green candle with musical notes floating upwards. The background has dark stormy skies, barren hills, and black vines with leaves framing the top of the image.
